notes:
## Fixed: updates that never finished
- The updater waited for Ignite3D to close, but counted the background process the Claude app keeps running (the Ignite3D bridge), so it kept saying "Ignite3D is open" after the editor had closed. It now ignores that process. This update already uses the fixed updater.

## Code tab
- New **Code** tab next to Inspector and Scene: every code file in the project in one place. Scripts and Web files (HTML, CSS, JS) with line counts, errors and whether they're in use; click one to edit it. Buttons make a new script, HTML, CSS or JS file.
